summary: Iteration 66 - Projects Module Optimization Testing Complete. All backend APIs (16/16 tests passed) and frontend UI features working correctly. New features: Implementation Matrix with phase toggles, Bitácora with date/text/submit, Priority dropdown (Alta/Media/Normal only), Anexos dialog with inherited attachments, NO notes button, NO expandable rows.
seed_data_creation: Used existing project PRY-2026-03-001-PRI (prj_b50654b1c659) with 5 banks in matrix and 3 inherited attachments. Created test bitácora entries during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Projects module optimized with new features. Project PRY-2026-03-001-PRI has implementation_matrix with 5 banks (Banco Mercantil fully completed, Banesco has 1/5). Bitácora has test entries from iterations 65 and 66. Priority only accepts Alta/Media/Normal. Old projects (PRY-2026-0001/0002/0003) don't have implementation_matrix.

backend_put_matrix_phase.description: Updates implementation matrix phase (bank_name, product_name, phase, completed). Validates phases: Notificado, Recibido, Configurado, Testeado, En Producción

backend_post_bitacora.description: Adds bitacora entry with text and execution_date. Returns entry_id, created_by, created_at

backend_put_priority.description: Updates priority. Only accepts Alta/Media/Normal. Rejects Baja/Urgente with 400

backend_get_implementers.description: Returns list of users with implementation cargos

backend_project_has_matrix_attachments_b.description: Projects include implementation_matrix (dict), attachments (list with inherited_from), bitacora (list)

frontend_projects_table_no_expandable.description: Table shows projects without expandable rows, without notes button. Has Asignar/Anexos/Detalle/Status buttons

frontend_priority_dropdown_inline.description: Priority displayed as inline dropdown with only Alta/Media/Normal options

frontend_anexos_dialog.description: Shows inherited attachments with '(heredado de cotización)' label and download links

frontend_project_detail_header.description: Shows Modelo de Pinpad and Banco Patrocinador fields in header

frontend_implementation_matrix.description: Shows Banks × Products × 5 phases. Checkboxes toggle phase completion. Shows progress (e.g., 5/5)

frontend_bitacora_section.description: Form with date picker, text input, Registrar button. Shows entries in reverse chronological order

frontend_phase_toggle_click.description: Clicking phase checkbox toggles completion state, updates via API, UI refreshes

mocked_apis_list: Resend email service (simulated when API key not configured)
